notes: The condition-name question of 1985-SR-XIV.2.2.3-5, answered once there: a later output-CD record's 88 entry is a VALUE clause that the record contains, and SR9, unlike REDEFINES SR9, writes no condition-name exception, so COBOL6169 is right. An 88 in the FIRST record is accepted (cd1), a VALUE or an 88 in a later one refused (s9v, cd2). The refuter confirmed the rest.
